rationale: Builds directly on the reverse-tail recurrent baseline and spends the run on a compact structural change rather than another scalar sweep. The new `tail_anchor_gates` let the recurrent tail progressively refresh its anchor after each reverse recurrent block, so later recurrent passes can reuse a learned moving anchor instead of the fixed decoder-output anchor. This keeps shapes and export behavior stable, adds only one small control tensor per tail block, preserves the current quant-aware endgame, and targets the still-promising reverse-tail anchor variant category without a broad rewrite.
title: Gated Reverse-Tail Anchor Refresh
